kcc_query_text_example: Minority small sericulture farmer with 3.0 acres irrigated mulberry garden in Sidlaghatta, Chikkaballapura; seeking working capital credit for dfl silkworm seed purchase and disinfection; inquiring about Central KCC crop loan at 4% interest subvention vs Karnataka PACS 0% interest cooperative loan.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: BESCOM agricultural power connection for sericulture plot

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Registered RTC in Sidlaghatta taluk prior to February 2019

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: Central Silk Board & Dept of Sericulture Karnataka: Chikkaballapura (Sidlaghatta/Chintamani) is the premier bivoltine/cross-breed sericulture cluster in South India, with high recurring seasonal input costs for cocoon rearing.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka credit query logs: Sericulture farmers asking about scale of finance for mulberry garden maintenance under KCC vs cooperative loans.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 6: Evaluates competing credit channels (Central KCC-MISS commercial route at 4% vs Karnataka State Cooperative Credit 0% route); Central KCC placed in Section A as confirmed actionable candidate; provisional PACS cooperative credit routed to Section B; PMFBY raw engine evaluates INELIGIBLE because Mulberry is absent from the static crop whitelist, but static omission does not establish legal exclusion; routed to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION pending sericulture insurance circular verification; KMDC Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to irrigated land type and existing borewell.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate Challenge 6 competing credit channels for Minority sericulture cultivator; decouple PMFBY static exclusion to Section B pending sericulture insurance verification; confirm KMDC Ganga Kalyana disqualification on existing water infrastructure.
